name: Bone-Swarm
type_and_alignment: Tiny swarm of Tiny beasts, unaligned
senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10

abilities.name: Carrion Dormancy
abilities.description: The swarm can burrow through corpses and loose earth, and it has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide within a corpse or grave soil. While dormant inside a corpse, it is indistinguishable from ordinary carrion insects.

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

abilities.name: Grave Tide (Recharge 5-6) (Reaction)
abilities.description: When one creature within 30 feet that the swarm can see must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target is poisoned by this swarm, it is also incapacitated until the end of its next turn. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stripped to a skeleton and the swarm regains 10 hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The swarm makes two Mandibles attacks.

actions.name: Mandibles
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage, or 9 (2d8) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

other_edition.lore: Grave beetles are a necromantic infestation bred in unburied battlefields, consuming the dead until their hunger turns to the living, and they retain the memories of every corpse they have stripped.
other_edition.immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned
lint_findings: reaction-trigger: Reactions/Grave Tide (Recharge 5-6) has no trigger — a Reaction is not a free action; it must state when it fires: "*Trigger:* <specific event>. *Response:* <what the creature does>."
swarm-heal-contradiction: Reactions/Grave Tide (Recharge 5-6) heals the swarm, but the Swarm trait says it can't regain Hit Points — the healing is stripped (heal-only entries are removed)
orphan-condition-ref: "Poisoned" is referenced as a state but nothing on the sheet applies it
phrasing-save-2014: Reactions/Grave Tide (Recharge 5-6): 2014 save grammar — the skeleton is "*<Ability> Saving Throw:* DC n, <target>. *Failure:* <effect>"

monsterName: a swarm of grave beetles that strips a body to bone in seconds
